business_summary: Zhejiang Jinke Tom Culture Industry Co., LTD. engages in the operation of Talking Tom and Friends franchise in China and internationally. The company also develops various educational, entertaining, and educational green and healthy mobile application products under the Talking Tom Adventure, My Angela 2, My Talking Tom, My Talking Tom 2, Talking Tom Gold Run, and Talking Tom Hero Parkour names. In addition, it is involved in content production, distribution, and operation; operates multi-function indoor theme park, including Talking Tom Brave Adventure Zone; and IP derivatives and licensing activities. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Jinke Culture Industry Co., LTD. and changed its name to Zhejiang Jinke Tom Culture Industry Co., LTD. in August 2021. The company was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
business_summary_ko: Zhejiang Jinke Tom Culture Industry Co., LTD. 중국 및 해외에서 Talking Tom and Friends 프랜차이즈 운영에 참여하고 있습니다. 또한 회사는 Talking Tom Adventure, My Angela 2, My Talking Tom, My Talking Tom 2, Talking Tom Gold Run 및 Talking Tom Hero Parkour라는 이름으로 다양한 교육적, 오락적, 교육적이며 친환경적이고 건강한 모바일 애플리케이션 제품을 개발합니다. 또한 콘텐츠 제작, 유통, 운영에도 참여하고 있습니다. Talking Tom Brave Adventure Zone을 포함한 다기능 실내 테마파크를 운영합니다. IP 파생상품 및 라이선스 활동. 회사의 이전 이름은 Zhejiang Jinke Culture Industry Co., LTD입니다. 회사명을 Zhejiang Jinke Tom Culture Industry Co., LTD로 변경했습니다. 2021년 8월. 이 회사는 2007년에 설립되었으며 중국 항저우에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
